title: Sol Yaged tangent
summary: Rowe compares Shearing to Sol Yaged, who also wouldn't let him leave.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: That happened to me with a guy named Sol Yaged.
But you know actually I wanted to be done. Because it wasn’t quite as enjoyable, but that was funny, he wouldn’t let me stop either.
Oh yeah, the clarinetist? He helped teach Steve Allen for “The Benny Goodman Story.”
